newsitem.title: USA: Williams, Production Operators get contract.
newsitem.headline: Williams, Production Operators get contract.

text.p: Williams Cos Inc and Production Operators Corp have been contracted to build and operate a natural gas injection project for the El Furrial reservoir in northeastern Venezuela, units of the companies said in a joint statement.
They said the 20-year contract with Lagoven SA, a subsidiary of Petroleos de Venezuela SA PDVSA, will result in the largest outsourced natural gas injection project in Venezuela.
Williams and Production Operators have 66-1/3 percent and 33-1/3 percent, respectively, interests in the prlect which will begin limited operation in eight months.
The project will become fully operational within 17 months, they said.
Natural gas injection is expected to increase the fields average production of 330,000 barrels daily by 15 to 20 percent. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
